dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is on sale today. Lmao 😂

If dogecoin ever reaches a dollar, I'm gonna pay off my car loan. If it never reaches .20 again, ah well. I got in early, only changed wallets (not sold) when it was high, and I'm about breaking even. I could have made money by selling then, but hindsight is 2020.

The whole crypto market is crashing. This is generally bad, but I'm not too worried. Dogecoin is falling with this trend and not on it's own. I have a shit ton of dogecoin. I'm only hosed if the market continues crashing. And not by much. Not by anything I'd really miss.
